name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: Health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
eligibility: Families identified under the SECC database as economically vulnerable.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
description: Cash assistance for institutional delivery to reduce maternal and infant mortality.
eligibility: Pregnant women from low-income households, especially in rural areas.

name: National Nutrition Mission (POSHAN Abhiyaan)
description: Improves nutritional outcomes for children, pregnant women, and lactating mothers.
eligibility: Children under 6, pregnant and lactating women through Anganwadi centres.

name: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana
description: Nutritional support for patients undergoing tuberculosis treatment.
eligibility: Any citizen registered as a TB patient under the national program.
